decisions.decision: How does a Mac [files] entry name a target in the backup clone?
decisions.ruling: A key root on a Mac [files] entry: "home" (the default) or "backup". Any other value stops the sync. On the repo side, a root key stops the sync. The table key stays a plain path; badRelPath also refuses a key whose first segment is @backup, on both sides, so no entry can write a row that reads as a backup row. A backup entry whose first segment is dotfiles or .git is an error of the entry (dotfiles/ holds the link targets of home entries; .git/ is the git folder of the clone). User, 2026-11-27: "root = \"backup\" key".
decisions.rejected: A backup: prefix in the table key

decisions.decision: What is a backup target on disk?
decisions.ruling: A real file in the clone, at <backup>/<path> (the root of the clone, not below dotfiles/). The link rule (state.backup, linkPlan) ignores it: no link from $HOME.
decisions.rejected: A link from $HOME into the clone

decisions.decision: What happens to a root = "backup" entry when macos.toml has no backup?
decisions.ruling: The sync skips the entry, as a skipped target, with a log line that names the reason (no backup in macos.toml).

decisions.decision: How does the manifest record a backup target?
decisions.ruling: The Mac manifest row path of a backup target is @backup/<path>. manifest.BadPath accepts @backup only as the first segment of a Mac row and refuses it as any other segment (x/@backup/y); the repo side refuses (skips with a log line, as each bad row) a row whose first segment is @backup. The stale rule resolves @backup/ to the clone. When backup is unset, the run keeps each old @backup/ row in the new manifest unchanged and deletes nothing, so a later run with backup set can still remove the file. When backup moves from clone A to clone B, a row resolves to B, and a file left in A stays: accepted, and the docs say so.

decisions.decision: What do requires, the dry run and mac check use for a backup entry?
decisions.ruling: requires of a backup entry is relative to the clone. The dry run and mac check print the full path in the clone.

decisions.decision: Who commits a backup target in the clone?
decisions.ruling: bootstrap never commits and never runs git in the clone. The user commits the new files, as with the backup links today.
decisions.rejected: The sync commits in the clone

decisions.ruling: Yes: one review unit after U1, because the change lands runnable engine code (cli/internal/).

decisions.decision: Who releases the engine after this plan, and when?
decisions.ruling: The user, by hand, with a signed tag bootstrap@X.Y.Z on main, as the standing consent says: a plan never releases. /vwf:execute raises the MINOR level in .config/bootstrap/releases.toml at landing. Plan 3 notes that its Mac entries need that release on the Mac before mac sync.

decisions.decision: Edge rules of the engine change (rulings review, round 2)
decisions.ruling: (a) The D3 skip line uses the existing skip form of file.go:61-66: `skip file  <show> (no backup in macos.toml)`, with the same outcome as a requires skip. (b) U1 adds its new case rows to the case table of e2e/mac/mac_test.go. (c) For a backup entry, the check of the first segment dotfiles is case-insensitive, and a .git segment at any depth, in any case, is refused. (d) The unknown-key message lists root on the Mac side only; the repo-side list does not change (cli/internal/selection/form_test.go:86 stays green). (e) The seed list of a removed Mac tool (cli/internal/core/plan.go:1358-1360, cli/internal/tui/tools.go:889-893) resolves a backup seed with the same resolve function. (f) The handled-target set and the entry lookup (file.go:53, :66) key a backup item by its row path @backup/<target>. (g) U4 regenerates cli/internal/source/testdata/toml-yq.golden for the new fixture (UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/source in cli/). (h) U3 updates docs/setup/index.md (:74-75, :360-365: the commit item and its pass check also cover the files that backup entries write at the root of the clone) and docs/setup/migrate-dotfiles.md (:190-191). (i) For a backup entry, the requires message says a path relative to the backup clone.
decisions.rejected: Leave each edge to the unit

decisions.ruling: (a) A root = "backup" entry accepts mode copy, template and seed; mode merge with root backup is an error of the entry, so no contribution item can target it. (b) core and the TUI get the clone from a new accessor beside Home() (for example Backup(), the absolute clone path, or "" when backup is unset); a backup seed is left out of the seed list when backup is unset or the clone folder is missing. (c) For a backup item, the walk top of file.go:75-80 is the real path of the clone, so the walk never reaches a parent folder of the clone.
decisions.rejected: Leave each edge to the unit
